name: mech-58-info-tile-room
source: mech-58-info-tile Test Level: info tile at (3,1) on the direct route from the spawn (1,1) to the gate (8,1), carrying the banner 'Collect both chips first - the gate only opens when none are left.' A player who steps over it without reading walks straight to the gate and finds it shut with both chips (3,3) and (5,5) still uncollected; reading it and collecting both chips first opens the gate to the exit portal (11,1). The chain-switch order demo (mechanic 28) is not built on main, so the room realises the same naive-fails / corrected-succeeds teaching shape with the core gate and chips.
